name: Vanikya Ai Mcp
description:
Vanikya AI MCP connects Claude Code to Vanikya AI platform, giving you image generation, SEO analysis, creative insights, and credits management all directly from Claude.
Generate stunning images, videos, vectors, and lottie animations using 16+ models including GPT-Image-1.5, Flux 2 Pro, and Google's Nano Banana. Run AI-powered SEO audits on any URL (single or batch). Get creative scoring and branding feedback on images. Check your credit balance and top up  without leaving your terminal.

Powered by an OAuth-authenticated MCP server with guided skills that handle the full workflow: prompt enhancement, credit estimation, generation, and polling.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills** and **1 command**.

- **Skills** (5): `creative-insights` (Use this skill when the user asks for creative or visual analysis of images, branding feedback, visual critique,…), `credits` (Use this skill when the user asks about their Vanikya credit balance, available credit packages or pricing, how…), `imagine` (Use this skill when the user asks to generate images, videos, vector graphics (SVG), or lottie animations; edit…), `seo-analysis` (Use this skill when the user asks to analyze SEO of a URL or website, run an SEO…), `setup` (Use this skill when the user asks how to connect Vanikya to Claude, configure the Vanikya MCP server,…)
- **Commands** (1): `vanikya-setup` (Set up the Vanikya MCP connection for Claude Code or Claude Desktop)

Installs with `claude plugin install vanikya-ai-mcp@claude-community` from `vanikya/vanikya-ai-mcp` (`plugins/vanikya-ai-mcp`).
